messages:
maya: quick thread: we need a clear decision for gateway protocol negotiation. do we mandate gRPC+proto at edge or implement a negotiation handoff so clients can stay json-first? looking for telemetry & rollout plan tradeoffs. cc @owen @felix

owen: short answer: negotiation gives flexibility but adds complexity and an extra RTT for some clients. if we implement fast-negotiation (early headers) overhead is small.

felix: we've seen two classes of customers: infra-led (ok with proto) and product teams (prefer json). negotiation buys us smooth UX but increases coupling in gateway logic. also watch for quota attribution when we translate.

zoe: telemetry point: if we have both paths, dashboard needs to split metrics by path (negotiated_proto=true/false). otherwise alerting will be noisy. also need a header-drop detector.

maya: proposal sketch: 1) default: json ingress (no client changes) 2) clients can opt-in to proto via early_neg header or via TLS ALPN? 3) gateway does zero-copy pass-through for proto clients, transcode for others 4) expose per-tenant canary toggle in console.

owen: ALPN on TLS is neat for native SDKs, but browsers can't set ALPN. so we need header + ALPN hybrid. also recommend a detection fallback: if content-type is application/grpc+proto then skip transcode.

felix: operational concerns: when we transcode, ensure claim headers (x-customer / x-tenant) are preserved and mapped into proto metadata. add a unit test that fuzzes common auth libs.

zoe: metrics to emit: route.path, negotiated_proto:{true,false}, transcode_ms (histogram), header_mapped:boolean, quota_claim_present:boolean. dashboard tiles: p50/p95 by negotiated_proto, quota-mismatch-rate, header-drop-rate.

maya: sample route YAML we could store in control-plane catalog:

```
- route: POST /v1/infer
  negotiate_proto: true
  proto_fastpath_header: x-rw-proto
  claim_mapping:
    tenant: x-tenant-id
    user: x-user
```

owen: rollout plan idea: a) enable negotiation in gateway but default to transcode b) add console toggle per-tenant c) run 10% canary for 48h and compare p95, quota-mismatch, header-drop d) progressive ramp.

felix: also include an automated eval: same prompt set to proto vs json path, diff metric on output tokens/score. if divergence > threshold -> rollback.

zoe: alert rules: header-drop > 0.05% -> page oncall; quota-mismatch > 0.1% -> slack notify infra-team; transcode_latency_p95 delta > 10ms -> slow-path flag.

deploy-bot: negotiation-feature toggle enabled for group beta at 3745120005 :rocket:

maya: owners: maya (control-plane + RFC), zoe (metrics + dashboard), felix (tests + auth mapping), owen (ops + canary). i'll draft an RFC and console mockups.

owen: tiny SDK ask: native clients set ALPN by default when available; browser SDK sets x-rw-proto header behind a flag.

felix: note - ensure we tag traces with edge.negotiated_proto=true/false and include proto_version tag for debugging.

maya: agreed. i'll add those to the tracing plan. thanks all :thumbsup:
